title: ayenia melantha
intro: Ayenia melantha, commonly known as Black Ayenia, is a plant species in the Rubiaceae family, native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of wounds, fever, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Ayenia melantha are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for its health benefits include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which have been shown to exhibit potential anticancer and cardiovascular-protective effects.
